title: Austin Tackles Streets, Approves Budget, & Grants Permits
summary:
*   **Significant Infrastructure Investment:** An ordinance was passed to dedicate 30% of property taxes towards improving streets and building bridges, with a portion specifically set aside for permanent paving.
*   **Annual City Budget Approved:** A comprehensive budget totaling over $312,000 for most city departments was officially approved.
*   **Fire Department Modernization Discussed:** The possibility of transitioning the Fire Department from an all-volunteer service to a paid department was on the agenda for future consideration.
*   **City Hospital Deficit Addressed:** Funds were reallocated from other departments to cover shortfalls at the City Hospital, specifically for essential supplies like food and ice.
*   **Urban Development and Regulation:** The city reviewed various permits for new construction and renovations, including approving a sleeping porch and an electric sign, while denying a large bulletin board sign.

Austin, Jan 22nd 1912.
The Council was called to order by the Mayor with all members present; Street fund The
Mayor laid before the Council an ordinance setting apart thirty per centum of the bridges
paving advalorem taxes of this City for the improvement of streets and building of bridges
within the City; segregating twenty per centum of said thirty per centum for Permanent
Paving ; making this ordinance re-troactive ,and repealing all ordinances and parts of
ordinances in conflict with the provisions hereof.
The ordinance was read the first time and passed under suspension of the rules by the
following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge ,Councilmen Bartholomew, Hart, Haynes & Powell 5
Nays none.

Budget 1912 The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Be it resolved by
the City Council of the City of Austin : That the budget submitted for this City by the
Mayor for all departments ,save the Water,Light and Power department,bearing date of
January 20th ,1912,and amounting to $ 312,743.32,be and the same is hereby approved.
Be it further resolved :
That the appropriations therein recommended be and the same are hereby made.
The resolution was read the first time and laid over.
The Council then recessed subject to call .

P.A. Ekdalito
Building permit
The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Th/at authority is hereby
granted to P A Ekdalito construct a sleeping porch in the rear of 117 West ninth street in
this City ( Robertson's Flats) Said sleeping porch is to be supported upon iron pipes and
to have galvanized iron roof. The only wooden part of said structure is the floor for said
porch and the joice for the same ,and the ceiling joice for the roofand the necessary
frame work for the screens to be placed in said work.The size of the porch to be ten feet
by twenty feet and one story high.
The work hereby authorized to be done must be done under the supervision and subject to
the approval of the City Engineer.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Bartholomew, Hart,Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
